1	# Content-aware evidence assertions with hash recording
 2	
 3	Extend Capture targets from existence-plus-non-zero-bytes to declarative content assertions: minimum byte size, regex match, JSON-path existence or value comparison, and expected line count. Record a SHA-256 hash and byte size of every verified artifact into gates.json. A PASS whose assertion fails is downgraded to FAIL with the specific failing assertion injected back into the live session, reusing the existing evidence-downgrade path.
 4	
 5	## Rationale
 6	The product's core differentiator is that verdicts are evidence-checked rather than trusted, but the check is currently satisfied by any non-empty file. An agent that writes one byte of garbage to the Capture path passes the gate — the exact failure mode Vigil exists to prevent. Hashes also unlock run comparison in Phase 4.
 7	
 8	## User Stories
 9	- [object Object]
10	- [object Object]
11	
12	## Acceptance Criteria
13	- [ ] The plan parser accepts assertion syntax on Capture lines covering at minimum: minBytes, matches (regex), jsonPath, and equals/contains for the resolved value
14	- [ ] A Capture target with no assertion retains today's existence + non-zero-bytes semantics, so all existing fixture plans pass unchanged
15	- [ ] A gate claiming PASS whose artifact exists but fails its regex assertion is recorded as FAIL in gates.json with a reason naming the assertion and the artifact path
16	- [ ] The failing-assertion instruction is injected into the live session via the existing inject path and appears in events.jsonl
17	- [ ] GateRecord.evidence entries gain sha256 and bytes fields, populated for every verified artifact including glob/brace expansions
18	- [ ] Assertion evaluation is bounded: files above a configurable maxAssertBytes are streamed or rejected rather than read wholly into memory
19	- [ ] Unit tests cover each assertion type passing and failing, plus malformed assertion syntax producing a parse-time error rather than a silent skip

- [ ] A gate claiming PASS whose artifact exists but fails its regex assertion is recorded as FAIL in gates.json with a reason naming the assertion and the artifact path
- [ ] The failing-assertion instruction is injected into the live session via the existing inject path and appears in events.jsonl
- [ ] GateRecord.evidence entries gain sha256 and bytes fields, populated for every verified artifact including glob/brace expansions
- [ ] Assertion evaluation is bounded: files above a configurable maxAssertBytes are streamed or rejected rather than read wholly into memory

1	# Vigil
 2	
 3	Agent-SDK TUI runner for gated validation plans and arbitrary prompts. Every tool call, gate verdict, hook decision, token and dollar is visible live in an animated cockpit — and persisted to disk so a run can be replayed or audited without the TUI.
 4	
 5	Built on `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk` (the Claude Code agent loop) + Ink.
 6	
 7	## Install
 8	
 9	```bash
10	cd ~/Desktop/vigil
11	npm install && npm run build && npm link      # → `vigil` on PATH
12	```
13	
14	Requires Node ≥ 20 and a Claude Code executable (`claude` on PATH, `CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH`, or `--claude-bin`).
15	
16	## Use
17	
18	```bash
19	vigil run ~/Desktop/OmniRoute/_tasks/planning/omp-live-deploy            # every plan, in order, halting on the first FAIL
20	vigil run …/omp-live-deploy --only 01-01                                  # one plan
21	vigil run …/omp-live-deploy --from 02-01 --to 02-02                       # a range
22	vigil prompt "Audit ~/.omniroute/logs for errors in the last hour"        # any prompt, same cockpit
23	vigil prompt -f brief.md --approvals all                                  # approve every tool call by hand
24	vigil replay <planRoot>/runs/<id> --speed 30                              # re-animate a recorded run
25	vigil tail   <planRoot>/runs/<id>                                         # follow a run from another terminal
26	vigil runs   <planRoot>                                                   # list runs with verdict + cost
27	vigil run … --plain                                                       # no TUI: readable line log (CI, ssh, logs)
28	```
29	
30	### Keys
31	
32	`space` pause (holds the next tool call) · `i` inject an instruction into the live session · `x` interrupt the current turn · `a` cycle approvals auto → gates → all · `e` evidence overlay (criteria ‖ captured file) · `t` tool detail (full input/output, `j`/`k` to walk) · `l` diagnostics level · `f` filter by source · `r` re-run a failed plan · `q` quit.
33	
34	## What Vigil enforces (beyond what the agent says)
35	
36	- **Verdict lines.** The runner contract appended to every plan requires `VG-<id>: PASS|FAIL <reason>` and `PLAN <id>: PASS|FAIL`. Vigil parses them from the stream.
37	- **Evidence on disk.** A gate's `Capture:` files must exist and be non-empty in the plan's `evidence/` directory; a claimed PASS with missing evidence is recorded as FAIL and the agent is told to capture for real.
38	- **Rails.** `PreToolUse` hook denies `git stash`, checkout/switch in the shared main checkout, `pkill -f`/`killall`, `rm -rf ~`, edits to `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`; warns on touching the real `~/.omp` config or the live OmniRoute DB. Configurable in `vigil.config.json → rails[]`.
39	- **Reports from observation.** `<phase>-VALIDATION.md` and the ROADMAP status table are written by Vigil from `gates.json`, not from agent prose.
40	
41	## Clean agent by default
42	
43	Vigil runs the agent with `settingSources: []` — none of your Claude Code user/project settings (plugins, hooks, skills, `env` overrides such as coordinator mode or context-size flags) are loaded, so a run is reproducible and its context stays small. Opt back in with `--settings user,project` or `settingSources` in config.
44	
45	## Config (`vigil.config.json` in cwd, or `~/.config/vigil/config.json`)
46	
47	```json
48	{
49	  "model": "cc/claude-fable-5-1",
50	  "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1",
51	  "authTokenEnv": "OMNIROUTE_API_KEY",
52	  "cwd": "/Users/nick/Desktop/OmniRoute/.claude/worktrees/omp-cli-tool",
53	  "approvals": "auto",
54	  "maxTurns": 400,
55	  "unsetEnv": ["NODE_ENV"],
56	  "addDirs": ["/Users/nick/.omniroute", "/Users/nick/Library/LaunchAgents", "/Users/nick/.omp"],
57	  "probes": [
58	    { "name": ":20219", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:20219/api/health", "expect": "\"status\":\"ok\"", "intervalSec": 20 },
59	    { "name": ":20128", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:20128/api/health", "intervalSec": 30 },
60	    { "name": "tunnel", "url": "https://router.hack.ski/api/health", "expect": "ok", "intervalSec": 30 },
61	    { "name": "launchd", "command": "launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/com.omniroute.autostart | grep -q 'state = running'", "intervalSec": 30 }
62	  ]
63	}
64	```
65	
66	## Run artifacts (`<planRoot>/runs/<id>/`)
67	
68	`events.jsonl` (every RunEvent) · `tools/NNNN-<tool>.txt` (full input/output per call) · `gates.json` · `cost.json` (per model) · `session.json` (SDK session ids → `--resume`).
69	
70	## Develop
71	
72	`npm test` (vitest: parser, verdicts, rails, reducer, reports, session enforcement) · `npm run typecheck` · `npm run build`.

1	# Phase 1 Plan 1: Build the fork and boot it on a scratch port
 2	
 3	Platform: full-stack
 4	Worktree: `~/Desktop/OmniRoute/.claude/worktrees/omp-cli-tool` (W below) · Evidence: `phases/01-build-stage/evidence/` (E below)
 5	Shell rule: every command runs with `env -u NODE_ENV` (the login shell exports `NODE_ENV=production`, which silently drops devDependencies and changes Next build mode). Kill by PID only.
 6	
 7	<mock_detection_protocol>
 8	Before executing any task: creating .test.*, mock libraries, in-memory DBs, TEST_MODE, a fake `/api/health` → STOP. Fix the REAL system. The scratch instance is the real server binary on a real copy of the real DB — not a fixture.
 9	</mock_detection_protocol>
10	
11	<plan_objective>
12	Produce `W/dist/server.js` from `c5ceeaa86` and prove the fork serves on `127.0.0.1:20239` against a byte-copy of the live DB, applying migrations 161→170, without touching :20219.
13	</plan_objective>
14	
15	<plan_context>
16	- `_tasks/planning/omp-live-deploy/BRIEF.md`, `ROADMAP.md`
17	- `W/bin/cli/commands/serve.mjs` (APP_DIR = `dist/` when `dist/server.js` exists), `W/package.json` (`build` → `scripts/build/build-next-isolated.mjs`)
18	- `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.omniroute.autostart.plist` (current 3.8.50 launcher — read only in this phase)
19	- `~/.omniroute/` (`storage.sqlite` 161 migrations, `server.env`, `logs/`)
20	</plan_context>
21	
22	<task id="1">
23	Name: Build the standalone bundle
24	Files: `W/dist/**` (build output), `E/vg1-build.log`
25	Action: `cd W && git status --porcelain` must be empty and `git rev-parse --short HEAD` = `c5ceeaa86`. Run `env -u NODE_ENV npm run build 2>&1 | tee E/vg1-build.log` in the background (Desktop Commander 60 s limit — poll the log). Then `node bin/omniroute.mjs --version | tee E/vg1-version.txt`.
26	Done: `dist/server.js` exists; version line printed.
27	</task>
28	
29	<validation_gate id="VG-1" blocking="true">
30	Prerequisites: worktree clean at `c5ceeaa86`; `node -v` ≥ 20; `~/Desktop/OmniRoute/node_modules` hard-linked or `npm ci --include=dev` done.
31	Execute: `ls -la W/dist/server.js W/dist/.next/BUILD_ID 2>&1 | tee E/vg1-dist.txt`; `tail -20 E/vg1-build.log`.
32	Capture: `E/vg1-build.log`, `E/vg1-dist.txt`, `E/vg1-version.txt`.
33	Pass criteria: build log ends with exit 0 and no `Error:`/`Failed to compile`; `dist/server.js` present; `vg1-version.txt` = `3.8.51`; `git status --porcelain` still empty (build output is ignored — if it is not, STOP: never commit `dist/`).
34	Review: READ the last 40 lines of `vg1-build.log`; grep it for `error` case-insensitively and explain every hit.
35	Verdict: PASS → Task 2 | FAIL → fix build (dependencies, NODE_ENV) → re-run.
36	Mock guard: no `--skip-build`, no copying `dist/` from the npm 3.8.50 install.
37	</validation_gate>
38	
39	<task id="2">
40	Name: Stage a scratch data dir from a byte-copy of production and boot the fork on :20239
41	Files: `~/.omniroute-scratch/` (new), `E/vg2-*.{txt,log}`
42	Action:
43	1. `sqlite3 ~/.omniroute/storage.sqlite ".backup '/Users/nick/.omniroute-scratch/storage.sqlite'"` (online-safe copy; do NOT `cp` a live WAL DB). Copy `server.env` alongside. Record `sqlite3 …scratch… "select count(*) from _omniroute_migrations"` → expect 161 → `E/vg2-migrations-before.txt`.
44	2. Find how the server locates its data dir (`grep -rn "OMNIROUTE_DATA_DIR\|\.omniroute" W/bin/cli/commands/serve.mjs W/src/lib/db/*.ts | head`) and record the env var name in `E/vg2-datadir-var.txt`. If it is HOME-derived only, run with `HOME=/tmp/scratch-home` and symlink `/tmp/scratch-home/.omniroute → ~/.omniroute-scratch`.
45	3. Start in the background: `env -u NODE_ENV OMNIROUTE_MAX_PENDING_MIGRATIONS=0 <datadir env> node bin/omniroute.mjs serve --port 20239 --no-open --log > E/vg2-serve.log 2>&1 &` and save `$!` to `E/vg2-pid.txt`.
46	Done: process alive; log shows listening on 20239.
47	</task>
48	
49	<validation_gate id="VG-2" blocking="true">
50	Prerequisites: VG-1 PASS; port 20239 free (`lsof -i :20239` empty); live :20219 health ok before starting (`E/vg2-live-before.json`).
51	Execute: poll `curl -s 127.0.0.1:20239/api/health` up to 90 s → `E/vg2-health.json`; `sqlite3 ~/.omniroute-scratch/storage.sqlite "select count(*) from _omniroute_migrations"` → `E/vg2-migrations-after.txt`; `curl -s 127.0.0.1:20219/api/health` → `E/vg2-live-after.json`; `sqlite3 ~/.omniroute/storage.sqlite "select count(*) from _omniroute_migrations"` → `E/vg2-live-migrations.txt`.
52	Capture: all of the above plus `E/vg2-serve.log`.
53	Pass criteria: scratch health `status == "ok"`; scratch migrations = **170** and live migrations still **161**; live health ok before and after; `vg2-serve.log` contains no `abort`, `EADDRINUSE`, or unhandled rejection; the process listed in `vg2-pid.txt` is the one bound to 20239 (`lsof -i :20239 -t`).
54	Review: READ `vg2-serve.log` end-to-end for migration lines (expect 9 applied) and any warning about `API_KEY_SECRET`/encryption key mismatch — a mismatch means `server.env` was not picked up: FAIL.
55	Verdict: PASS → 01-02-PLAN | FAIL → fix data-dir wiring → re-run (delete and re-copy the scratch DB first).
56	Mock guard: if tempted to boot with an empty DB "to make it start" → STOP; the point is migrating real data.
57	</validation_gate>
58

60	Total gates: 2 | Sequence: VG-1 → VG-2 | All BLOCKING | Evidence: phases/01-build-stage/evidence/ | Leaves the scratch server running for 01-02.
61	</gate_manifest>
